description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for setting up, managing, and tearing down WireGuard VPN interfaces, including peer configuration, key management, and network routing.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes WireGuard configuration parameters such as private key, listen port, mtu, and fwmark.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures a WireGuard peer, including public key, preshared key, allowed IPs, endpoint, and persistent keepalive, and adds routing if specified.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Checks if the private key for a network interface is set to 'generate' and creates a new key if needed.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up the WireGuard interface, including key generation, interface creation, IP address assignment, and endpoint configuration.
